method: Keep measured r6 training and preprocessing cost; scale maximum old validation time by window-count ratio; add CPU synthetic candidate p90, epoch aggregation allowance, checkpoint write allowance, and 10% total headroom. No speedup assumed from batch/AMP changes: both equal r6.
limitations: CPU synthetic decode is a cost probe, not a GPU benchmark or measured accuracy.
r15 serial float32 inference (batch 2) is a different path from r6 bf16 batch 4 with four loader workers; its 684/1170/1628-second model times are not treated as per-epoch Lightning validation times.
The estimate is not a guarantee; external timeout terminates at 8h and no retry or epoch extension is authorized.
Peak VRAM is an estimate; 8 GiB allocator cap leaves room for CUDA context/driver outside PyTorch.
